name: Modao Battalion
headerMeta: Golden era · Pike/Polearm infantry · anti-cav · 310 leadership · Seasonal (S19: Alexander)
pitch: An anti-cavalry support pikeman that stacks massive flat damage reduction through two defense-stacking abilities and doctrine builds, enabling it to tank anything while respecting that pikeman units don't lead charges. Played correctly it beats cavalry decisively; played wrong (sent in first or alone on a flank) it dies instantly.

doctrines.name: Anti-Cavalry Doctrine V
doctrines.note: −40% dmg taken from cav while bracing, +16% dmg vs cav while bracing {1}

doctrines.name: Hero DMG Doctrine V
doctrines.note: penetration makes huge difference against high-tier units {1}

veterancy.label: Top line (17 points)
veterancy.body: Damage-focused — strategy is to out-damage bottom-vet durability gains with top-line damage nodes paired with flat doctrine reduction {2}.

veterancy.label: Bottom line
veterancy.body: Durability — skippable when flat-reduction doctrines already exceed its entire defensive value {2}.

battleRole.positioning: Support the front line, not the front line itself — you don't go first, others do, so shield moves, you follow. Always watch your back for incoming cavalry. {2} Against infantry: X-move in, engage with skill 2, instantly press skill 3 right after, then skill 2 again, then brace for best burst. {1}
battleRole.tips: When skill 2 comes off cooldown each time, press skill 2 and re-brace — sustains best burst in blob fights. {1} Maintain formation with X to prevent spreading and enemy cavalry punishes; second skill targets nearest enemies and causes spread in open areas. {2} Brace 1–2s before cavalry arrives — this is non-negotiable. {1} You can reset Toughness Doctrine's first-8-hits mitigation by swapping at supply and re-taking the unit. {1} Modao Defense and Modao March each increase all-defense by 100 for 3s on hit, stacking to 15 — two stacks alone exceed entire bottom vet line's defensive value (32% infantry / 45% cavalry mitigation with doctrines). {2}

controls.notes: Five engagement combos depend on scenario {2}: full engagement (charge → stab → brace {2}), soft engagement for high-damage targets (charge → brace {2}), defense (brace → wait → stab → brace loop, only stab near brace cooldown end {2}), full counter-engagement (brace → wait → charge → stab → brace {2}), soft counter-engagement (brace → wait → charge → brace → stab → brace {2}). Core discipline: cycle skill 2 (stab) and skill 3 (march/defense stack-building ability) to maintain and increase your 15-stack defense bonus — only use stab once brace is nearly off cooldown, minimizing windows without flat reduction. {2}
